name: sor-vscode
description: Shows which code comes from which clause of the spec, and whether they still agree.

commands.title: Spec of Record: Toggle marker lines
Spec of Record: Toggle live preview
Spec of Record: Show code of this clause

sor.pythonPath.description: Python used to run the sor tool. Empty: py -3 on Windows, python3 elsewhere.

sor.toolPath.description: Path of tools/sor.py. Empty: looked for in the project folder and every folder above it, then the copy that ships with the extension.

sor.hideMarkerLines.description: Hide the @clause comment lines in code files (display only; the files never change).

sor.livePreview.description: Show spec files formatted while you type: **, braces and backticks hidden except on the line you edit (display only).

scripts.test: node test/grammar.js && node test/bundle.js && node test/regions.js && node test/run.js ../../examples/solar-system
